messages:
Marta: Heads-up — after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak + wider prefetch we saw continuous-batcher latency regressions in prod. P50 steady, P95 +12%, P99 +18% on gpt-medium. Observed more soft-429s at tail.

Jake: Oof. Do we have a perf profile? canary/ci? :thinking:

Marta: Uploading a quick flame view — link: https://perf.internal/runs/4290012345

Sara: KV-hit dropped from 86% -> 62% after prefetch-window change (2048 -> 4096). That increases downstream per-token work because KV misses force kernel fallback to the full-attention path.

Nidhi: Which kernel path triggered? I saw more fallthrough to slow attention-kernel_v2 and some extra memcpy on the warmup path.

Marta: Right — kernel selector started favoring kernel_v2 for longer seqs; the batcher assembled bigger, mixed-length batches so warmup + kernel switch cost went up.

Jake: Can we reproduce in staging with the exact seq-length distribution? If yes we should try preferring homogeneous slices before merging.

Sara: Quick mitigation idea: tighten token_budget targets on the continuous batcher and cap per-request prefetch. Proposal: token_budget=1024, kv_prefetch=128, homogenous_slice=true. Also add a soft-429 flow when queue occupancy > 80% to avoid blocking and cascading stalls.

Marta: Example config I tested in staging:
```
continuous_batcher:
  token_budget: 1024
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  kv_prefetch: 128
  homogenous_slice: true
  soft_429_threshold: 0.8
```

Nidhi: Ran a short canary with that — P99 down ~7%, kv-hit back to ~81%, 429-rate reduced vs the previous spike. No 500s. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started (deployment id: canary-2026-03-18-12) — monitoring: latency, kv_hit, 429_rate

Jake: Action items: (1) run 12h A/B in prod with new batcher config; (2) enable kernel-selector telemetry to log chosen kernel per-batch and seq-length histograms; (3) add regression alert: kv-hit delta > 5% and P99 increase > 10% over baseline.

Marta: I'll file a short playbook + rollback plan. If A/B shows regressions we gate the kernel-selector change and revert to previous kernel heuristic. Thanks all. :pray:
